item.alone_adventure.crystalline_heart.t: A heart condensed from crystal, the crystals on it still shifting in color.
Regenerates 1 shield every 10 seconds after taking damage
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield capacity and regen speed
item.alone_adventure.bleedingshield.tool: A shield forged from congealed blood, the blood still seeks to erode its wielder.
Reduces max health by 20%, grants +30% armor
item.alone_adventure.adaptive_flesh.tool: A squirming piece of living tissue that seems to learn alongside your pain.
Each hit of a damage type grants 1 layer of adaptation (15% per layer, max 5); taking a different damage type decays all existing layers by 1
item.alone_adventure.night_contract.tool: A pact signed in blood; moonlight is its gift, sunlight its curse.
In sunlight (daytime, unobstructed sky): health cannot regenerate, and you are afflicted with Wither
At night (indoors or outdoors): restores 1 health every 4 seconds and grants Night Vision
Can sleep during the day; sleeping in daylight skips straight to nightfall
Brighter moon phases grant higher bonuses: new moon +10%, up to full moon +50% movement speed and crit damage
Current moon: %1$s -- +%2$s movement speed and crit damage
item.alone_adventure.broken_mask.tooltip: A cracked stone mask, whispering of a forgotten pact.
20% chance on hit to inflict Vulnerability I (10s) on the target
When the target's Vulnerability is consumed: 50% chance to gain Strength I (5s) and restore 10 health
Base: +7 Armor, +20% Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness
Active skill (default key R): inflict Vulnerability II (1 min) on all entities within 8 blocks; heal half of max health and gain Resistance II (1 min); 90s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.binding_bandage.too: An old herb-soaked bandage; the tighter it binds, the less willing you are to fall.
50% chance on hit to give yourself Endurance I (3s: +speed, +jump, hunger locked); does not stack or refresh
Attacks against Weakness-affected targets deal +2 damage per Weakness level
Active skill (default key R): gain 1 shield point (max 3), 3 min cooldown; incoming damage is negated and costs 1 shield point
item.alone_adventure.survival_whimper.to: A whimper that refuses to die; uses your last breath to escape death.
On a fatal blow: immune to this damage
Teleports back to your respawn point (or world spawn if no bed)
item.alone_adventure.dragon_power.toolti: The bloodline of dragons flows within; death itself dares not claim you.
On a fatal blow: immune to this damage and revive in place with full health
item.alone_adventure.parryshield.tooltip: Raise this shield at the moment an enemy strike lands for a perfect defense.
Block within 1s of raising: full immunity, reflects 250% damage and weakens the attacker for 3s (1s parry cooldown)
Held up longer: absorbs 80% of the damage
A mysterious weapon of an imperial far future, its blade driven by highly compressed energy, cleaving far beyond ordinary alloys.

Pierce: main attacks ignore armor toughness; against enemies with armor above 8, +0.3 damage per point over the threshold, and +0.5 per point of toughness above 6 (up to 10 total), this damage ignores armor and toughness

Overclock: activate with right-click (lasts 13s by default, costs 5 durability), grants Resistance II for 5s on activation, +50% attack damage while active, +3 fire damage and 4s ignition per hit, heals 60% of damage dealt; 30s cooldown (duration and cooldown configurable)
item.alone_adventure.chainsawsword.toolt: A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, relying on serrated teeth to cut through foes.

Tear: Normal hits stack 4 levels, sweep hits have a 50% chance to stack 2 levels (refreshes on hit). When duration ends, settle once for damage = level × 0.6, then halve the level, re-apply with half level and continue settling until level reaches zero.

Sweep: Right-click to activate (lasts 7s, costs 3 durability, 15s cooldown). During activation, deals 1 damage every 0.2s to entities in front within 6 blocks cone (blocked by obstacles), and stacks 2 Laceration levels on hit (50% chance). Sweep damage ignores all armor and armor toughness.
item.alone_adventure.painstrike_hammer.t: A brutal heavy hammer whose every blow punishes a crowd, breaking down their guard.
Area strike: enemies within 2 blocks of the impact take 60% attack damage and stack Vulnerability (allies and tamed mobs unaffected)
Vulnerability: each hit (area hits included) stacks +2 Vulnerability
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: Ink condensed into blades; they scatter on impact and slowly reclaim themselves from the void.
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.t: Right-click to throw a blade: deals 3 damage and stacks Weakness (+1 level per hit, max level V, 5s), 0.15s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: Forged of ink, it never breaks: each throw costs 1 durability, idle blades regen 1 per 0.5s (2 per second)
item.alone_adventure.shock_device.toolti: A portable discharge device; once thrown, it crackles with arcs that bite anything nearby.
Right-click to throw (snowball trajectory): discharges while in flight, anchors in place on impact and keeps discharging for 5s; 0.5s throw cooldown
Shock: deals 1 damage every 0.1s to all creatures within 4 blocks (spares the thrower), up to 50 damage in total; hit targets also gain Slowness I (1.5s)
item.alone_adventure.regiment_banner.too: A company standard bearing the regiment's honor; plant it, and the line holds.
Right-click to plant it where you stand (30s): players within 8 blocks gain Resistance II and Endurance I; 120s cooldown
Players entering the banner's range are topped up to 10 absorption points (once per player per banner)
8 uses per durability, breaks when depleted; repairable with gold ingots in an anvil (2 points per ingot); not stackable, cannot be enchanted
item.alone_adventure.sealed_throne.toolt: A throne crystallized from starlight; its wearer will gradually draw forth its radiance.
Each star +5% attack damage; every 4 stars +2 armor
When hit and hearts are actually lost, lose 2 stars (shield absorption prevents star loss)
Active skill (default R): consume all stars, gain 1 shield per 6 stars (max 4), gain equal yellow hearts (20s)
item.alone_adventure.charging_core.toolt: A core cycling between forms; the longer it charges, the stronger its release on switching.
Thunder Form: max 6 layers, 10s per layer; attacks deal +5% damage per layer; on switch: Strength (layers+1) for 15s
Frost Form: max 10 layers, 15s per layer; +1 armor and half a point of toughness per layer; on switch: yellow hearts equal to layers (1:1)
Dark Form: max 5 layers, 30s per layer; no passive; on switch: next attack deals +layers×8 damage
Active skill (default key R): switch to the next form and release its charge, 5s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.hunter_serum.toolti: A murky serum charged with predator instinct; when drawn, the world fades to gray and nothing stays hidden.
Passive: effects gained from syringes come with +1 level, and their duration stacks with existing effects of the same kind

Active skill (default key R): Hunter Vision -- the view turns grayscale, highlighting creatures (red), dropped items (blue) and containers (yellow) in range (visible through walls, only to you); while active, attacks ignore 40% of the target's armor and 20% of its toughness; lasts 15s, 60s cooldown
tooltip.alone_adventure.golden_beetroot: Grants Endurance I for 60 seconds when eaten, also used to brew Endurance Potion
item.alone_adventure.quest_contract.tool: A contract curio recording its holder's trials - active when worn as a curio. Complete all tasks to unlock as a crafting material. Right-click with materials in offhand to submit progress.
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_r: ✔ Contract fulfilled - now usable as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_l: ✘ Complete all tasks before using as a crafting material
message.alone_adventure.quest.all_done: Contract fulfilled! This item is now usable as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.sailor_spinach: Restores 4 hunger and 8 saturation when eaten, and grants Strength II (30s) and Regeneration II (10s)
item.alone_adventure.injection_empty.too: An empty syringe used to craft potion syringes
tooltip.alone_adventure.injection_templa: This syringe has no effects (place a potion in the crafting grid)
item.alone_adventure.monster_ash.tooltip: Ash left behind by slain hostile creatures (unaffected by Looting; drops more plentifully with Hunter Serum worn)
item.alone_adventure.blood_shard.tooltip: Blood essence left after slaying hostile creatures (unaffected by Looting; higher drop rate with Hunter Serum worn)
item.alone_adventure.first_aid_kit.toolt: Instantly restores 60% of max health, 120s cooldown per use (3 uses; not stackable, cannot be enchanted)
item.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.too: A tireless little music box; the melody is beautiful, and the price is steep.
Right-click to use: instantly gain 90 shield points that absorb incoming final damage 1:1, lasting until depleted or death
Curse: in 60 seconds the melody ends and you die instantly -- totems, shields and fatal-damage immunity trinkets cannot save you, and relogging won't help
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.used: The eerie melody begins to turn...
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.warn: §cThe music box is about to stop...
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.bar: Music Box Shield: %s points ｜ your life will be claimed in %s seconds
item.alone_adventure.gun.tooltip.usage: Left-click to fire / Right-click to aim (halves spread) / Press R (or Sneak + Right-click) to reload / Press G to switch ammo
item.alone_adventure.gun.tooltip.dual: While dual-wielding guns, hold Left-click to fire alternately (fire rate tracked per gun)
gun.alone_adventure.stat.line4: Penetration %s | Ricochet %s | Knockback %s | Range %s blocks | Aim %sx
gun.alone_adventure.stat.ammo_types: Ammo selection: %s (%s types, cycle with G)
item.alone_adventure.imperial_eagle.tool: The two-headed eagle emblem of the Imperium, symbolizing glory and immortality.
Inverts negative effects: Weakness->Strength, Slowness->Speed, Darkness->Night Vision, Poison->Regeneration
Immune to fire and lava damage
Active skill (default key R): Resistance II, Strength I, Regeneration II for 2 minutes, 30s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.starlight_greatswor: A heavy blade awash with starlight; the longer it is held, the brighter it glows.
Charge: held in hand it gathers 1 starlight layer every 3 seconds (max 20)
On hit: base 15 damage, +10% per layer, and damage absorption (golden hearts, stacks every 3 seconds), then the charge resets
item.alone_adventure.reaper_scythe.toolt: A massive scythe; each unique mob you kill empowers it with additional damage.
item.alone_adventure.machine_claw.toolti: A robot limb forged by forgotten ancient technology; it strikes fast, and the deeper the streak, the harder it tears.
Combo: base damage 3; each landed hit adds +1 damage to subsequent attacks; resets if no hit lands within 2 seconds (misses included)
item.alone_adventure.ham_club.tooltip.de: A whole cured ham; fight on and stay fed.
item.alone_adventure.ham_club.tooltip.fo: Each attack restores 3 food; turns into a bone when its 32 durability runs out
item.alone_adventure.valkyrie_helmet.too: A winged leather helm; a valkyrie whispers at your ear.
Leather helmet defense +2 (3 total); +10% damage dealt while worn
item.alone_adventure.resurrection_contra: A contract curio with the power to resurrect - active when worn as a curio. Complete all tasks to unlock as a crafting material. Right-click with materials in offhand to submit progress.
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_r: ✔ Contract fulfilled - now usable as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_l: ✘ Complete all tasks before using as a crafting material
